-- TODO: Replace with actual source HIS clinical data query
-- Returns latest vitals, medications, investigations, allergies, diagnoses, procedures, notes
SELECT
  mrn,
  latest_vitals::json,
  active_medications::json,
  pending_investigations::json,
  allergies::json,
  diagnoses::json,
  procedures::json,
  clinical_notes::json
FROM clinical_profile_view
WHERE mrn = '{{ $json.mrn }}'

INSERT INTO bcp_patient_clinical_profile (
  tenant_id, source_system, mrn, patient_id, encounter_id,
  latest_vitals, active_medications, pending_investigations,
  allergies, diagnoses, procedures, clinical_notes,
  last_synced_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $env.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID }}',
  'HIS',
  '{{ $json.mrn }}',
  NULL, NULL,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.latest_vitals || {}) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.active_medications || {}) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.pending_investigations || {}) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.allergies || {}) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.diagnoses || {}) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.procedures || {}) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.clinical_notes || {}) }}'::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, source_system, mrn)
DO UPDATE SET
  latest_vitals = EXCLUDED.latest_vitals,
  active_medications = EXCLUDED.active_medications,
  pending_investigations = EXCLUDED.pending_investigations,
  allergies = EXCLUDED.allergies,
  diagnoses = EXCLUDED.diagnoses,
  procedures = EXCLUDED.procedures,
  clinical_notes = EXCLUDED.clinical_notes,
  last_synced_at = NOW();

-- Column names must match bcp_sync_status in backend/prisma/schema.prisma.
-- The row is created by the seed (backend/prisma/seed.ts) for each of the
-- three sync components, so a plain UPDATE is sufficient.
--
-- records_failed is 0 because this node is only reached on the success
-- path: the workflow has no per-record failure tracking, so it never
-- reports PARTIAL. Adding that means counting rejected rows upstream
-- and branching here.
UPDATE bcp_sync_status SET
  sync_status = 'SUCCESS',
  last_successful_sync_at = NOW(),
  last_attempt_at = NOW(),
  records_processed = {{ $items().length }},
  records_failed = 0,
  error_message = NULL
WHERE sync_component = 'CLINICAL_PROFILE'
  AND tenant_id = '{{ $env.DEFAULT_TENANT_ID }}';
